headline: SLEEPWATCH v5 — the wire tells the truth about when
lede: The board can no longer mistake an old sleep for news: churn tokens now carry their age, overlapping sleep sources are counted once, and stale strips name the minute they were baked.

notes.text: Churn self-dates: six hours after the last dark wake the strip reads STUDIO CHURNED — N sleeps in W-min bursts · latest 6h ago, never 'in the last 30 min'. A live episode keeps the old wire byte-identical.

Partial overlap double-counts no more: when pmset names a sleep that a tick-gap only inferred, the raw claim clips to its uncovered parts — digest totals are honest unions (a night that read 8h 00m now reads 5h 40m).

sleepwatchcheck grew to 314 gates (+40): clip/seam/noise cases, tense pins, ledger-clip end-to-end. Mutants prove it can fail: neutralizing the clip reddens 15 gates, inverting the tense switch reddens 6.

A guard defined but never wired into its condition is invisible until arithmetic exposes it — the merged window's min=180 was exactly the double-count that could only mean the merge branch ran. Read the number; the impossible result is the clue.
